ITEM 1 | White cooked grains, fluffy separate long grains with slight sheen, mounded in a loose heap on the left side of the plate, covering roughly 12% of the plate, about 3 cm tall at the peak | 150
ITEM 2 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, crinkled and glossy, a loose pile of about 10 leaves with visible stems in the upper area of the plate, covering roughly 7% of the plate, about 1 cm tall | 25
ITEM 3 | Small oval cherry tomatoes, bright red-orange with smooth glossy skins, whole and intact, about 2.5 cm long each, clustered in the lower left of the plate, about 10 pieces covering roughly 14% of the plate, about 2.5 cm tall | 150
ITEM 4 | Red grapes, dark red to burgundy with some pale green-yellow ones, smooth glossy skins, whole and firm, about 1.5 cm diameter each, in a curved arc along the right edge of the plate, about 14 grapes covering roughly 9% of the plate, about 1.5 cm tall | 100
ITEM 5 | Roasted potato chunks, golden-tan with browned edges and some dry patchy crust, cut into irregular cubes about 2.5 to 3 cm per side with a few flat faces, sitting in a cluster on the right-center of the plate, covering roughly 14% of the plate, about 2 cm tall | 160
